test_cases.name: PHI scrubbing from telemetry exports
test_cases.input_setup: Sanitize clinical note telemetry entry containing patient names and clinical text
test_cases.expected_result: Zero PHI in sanitized telemetry; raw transcript fields deleted
test_cases.evidence: All sensitive clinical narrative fields scrubbed; only hash and metadata exported

test_cases.name: Trace correlation across pipeline steps
test_cases.input_setup: Propagate trace context across audio preprocessing, extraction, and diagnosis spans
test_cases.expected_result: Consistent trace_id maintained across all spans in request lifecycle
test_cases.evidence: Distributed trace correlation preserved across 3 spans with trace_id=trace-4bf92f3577b34da6a3ce929d0e0e4736

test_cases.name: Custom dimensions attached to telemetry
test_cases.input_setup: Construct event properties with department, language, and conversation mode
test_cases.expected_result: dept, language, and mode cleanly attached as custom dimensions

test_cases.name: Log level filtering & PHI barrier
test_cases.input_setup: Inspect telemetry handler implementation and log filtering policies
test_cases.expected_result: Sensitive clinical texts are categorically excluded from Application Insights
test_cases.evidence: Telemetry source code documents and enforces strict PHI exclusion boundary

test_cases.name: Performance counters and dependency metrics
test_cases.input_setup: Aggregate latency and dependency metrics over 5 pipeline sessions
test_cases.expected_result: Durations, downstream dependency metrics, and failure rates visible
